mapper.select: SELECT c.ent_time, c.id, c.car_stat, c.ex_time, c.cost, c.spc_no, c.discnt_at, m.car_num FROM car c JOIN member m ON c.id = m.id WHERE m.car_num LIKE CONCAT('%', #{car_num}) AND c.car_stat = 1 ORDER BY c.ent_time DESC
SELECT c.ent_time, c.id, c.car_stat, c.ex_time, c.cost, c.spc_no, c.discnt_at, m.car_num FROM car c JOIN member m ON c.id = m.id WHERE c.discnt_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.discnt_at DESC
